# Lisbon Cold Locker (release fixture)

This is the committed seed that `scripts/real-room-run.cjs` births into a throwaway room at every release cut. It is small on purpose: four sections, five artifacts, five typed claims and a handful of named entities, enough for the quick run, the deep run, Eureka and analogies to each have something real to chew on. Every name below is invented. Nothing here is a real person, firm or measurement.

The governing question above names a city (Lisbon) and a product (a solar-powered cold locker). A reader of the grant card can check, from those two words alone, whether the research lines the planner proposes are about this venture and not about something else.
